name: Petit Fleur -Oka o Wataru Crystal no Kaze-
original_name: Petit Fleur -丘を渡るクリスタルの風-
source: Miki suddenly finds himself transported to a mysterious other world. There, he finds a person trapped inside a crystal pillar. Miki only has 29 days to rescue them.
translation: Miki突然发现自己被传送到一个神秘异世界。在那里，他看见一个被困在水晶柱中的人。Miki只有29天时间救出对方。
